why: The style book: one file a style, in this order (plain first, the baseline).

mix.why: Each member's loudness against the melody's, in dB, the mix check's targets (task 3.8; DadCraft, Oct 26: one default, a style overriding it when his ear says so): the melody on top, 0-3 dB over the loudest other member; the drums, the percussion and the bass 0-4 dB under it; the pad and the arp 5-10 dB under; the keys 3-8 dB under and the horns 0-6 dB under (task 3.4c: new members, new defaults); each rhythm guitar 3-8 dB under (task 3.4d: two of them, left and right, together near the lead).
